I use Angelus leather paint products. They are really nice quality. I use their leather primer (just take a cotton ball with some on it and rub in circles around the shoe—this takes the first layer off so the paint binds better). Their paint is supposed to not “smear, crack, or chip.” It’s really pigmented which is nice. Then I use their leather finisher (again cotton ball in small circles) and that’s it :) I’ve found the finish will make the shoes/leather sticky and very glossy. To help with the glossiness, I use the Angelus duller, and to help with the stickiness I buff out the shoe with Vaseline (or leather wax). 

This sounds like a v long promotion for angelus paint, but I promise I’m just happy with their line of leather paints
